title: Reusable-Cup and Bottle Adoption
dataSources: Carbon estimates (`carbon:estimate`), recycling weight (`recycling:weight`), food waste (`foodwaste:log`), repairs (`repair:event`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — carbon-footprint apps, home recycling scales, food-waste logs, and repair / reuse journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=carbon:estimate category=beverage
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(eval(if(container_type="reusable",1,0))) as reusable_uses, count as drink_events by _time
| eval adoption_pct=round(100*reusable_uses/drink_events,1)
| sort - _time
description: Shows whether reusable cup and bottle habits are becoming your default for purchased drinks.
value: Small repeated packaging choices compound quickly, and an adoption rate reveals whether the habit is sticking.
implementation: Tag beverage carbon events by container type and calculate monthly reusable adoption percentage.
visualization: Line chart of reusable container adoption percentage.

references.title: EPA — reducing wasted food at home

grandmaExplanation: It warns how often you remember to use a reusable cup or bottle instead of a throwaway one.
